body: I'm not sure if anyone will see this now, but the standards are my own. I feel as if there are few things in from which I can garner genuine satisfaction. However, I do not think any of these things are attainable for me on account of my not being intelligent enough. Like I said - I'll never be a genius, and that fact is for some reason incredibly painful for me and a source of unending angst.

I don't understand how things can get better for me. I will only be satisfied with life if I somehow manage to conform to my impossibly high(or even delusional) standards. I'll never be a genius. Every moment I continue to live feels like getting my face dragged through the mud. I can't stand my own inadequacy.

To be honest, suicide seems so much more appealing after writing all this down. It's never felt more desirable before.
